name: Eleven-speed outboard-chainline double crankset
weight_description: Manufacturer average 728 g for FC-MT700-B2, 170 mm arms and 36/26T chainrings, explicitly without bottom bracket and without chain/bash guard. This is the 2025–2026 reference for the 51.8 mm chainline B2 model; the standard FC-MT700-2 and other ring combinations remain separate.
